advice: Phototherapy (NB-UVB) 2-3 times a week if widespread. Avoid friction and injury on skin (Koebner). Repigmentation is slow; review every 2-3 months. Check thyroid function.
name: Vitiligo

rx.sig: Oral mini-pulse: 1 tab on 2 consecutive days per week (only for active disease)

rx.instr: Apply once daily on body patches, 2 weeks on / 1 week off
Apply twice daily on face, neck and genital patches
